dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single prominent white band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against dark gray flight feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale bluish-white edges visible along the borders of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, irregular pale patch is visible on the posterior neck between the black crown and green mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, high-contrast boundary separating the black crown from the pale nape and olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white cheek patch surrounded by black plumage extending from the crown to the throat area.
